::: {#hero-heading}
I am a senior health economist and data scientist working on managed care, healthcare financing, and value-based care. My bread and butter is healthcare claims data.

I teach data science and programming for economists at the **University of St. Gallen**, and co-organize the **Zurich R User Group**.

I am engaged in politics with the Green Liberal Party, and I am an elected member of the Audit Commission of the Flawil township.

Else: I run half-marathons and 10k races, bike granfondos, cook and bake.

Feel free to **get in touch** using my contact info.
:::
